implementation: Failed optional expression probes leave their token for validation/deferred binding, preventing silent omission in TRAN, TEMP, STEP, NOISE and MC fields.
An ordered private plan retains the first failed root analysis and subsequent ready/pending cards. Successful earlier cards and later ready operands preserve eager evaluation.
Pending cards retry original tokens and grammar against completed root bindings, overlaid with already available authored values, strings, functions and temperature builtins.
Deferred root cards bind after the existing parameter/source/model completion phases; failed sampled probes use isolated counters and shared parameter samples are reused.

Complete card and LIN/noise constraint validation precedes publishing queued effects. Output requests and diagnostics merge linearly into their saved positions among other directives; MC source bytes and spans remain authored.
Observe cancellation between deferred cards and publication entries; keep parser AST and existing engine/control dispatch unchanged.
Share physical diagnostic attribution between ordinary line publication and analysis staging, so delayed warnings retain included source paths and local lines.
acceptance_evidence: Six invalid optional-field cases fail instead of silently dropping an authored operand.
Bare, signed, ordinary/global and already-declared forward DC operands execute a resistor-divider oracle in both expression dialects.
Twenty-six numeric analysis/auxiliary families match literal-card parsing after binding, including optional TRAN fields, periodic and quasi-periodic cards.
Public AC and transient schedules execute bound frequencies/times against a resistor-divider oracle.
Known complex values, lazy branches and user functions retain authored bindings despite subsequent redefinitions.
Mixed ready/pending cards preserve analysis order, Fourier/FFT output owners, non-analysis outputs and parameter/analysis diagnostic order.
Ready draws precede the existing declaration completion phases; pending cards draw once afterward and reuse a source/model/parameter sample.
Duplicate LIN and conflicting noise settings report the later authored card; literal-only noise seeds remain literal-only.
Pending root cards cannot read child-only parameters; ready child cards keep their local values and authored global analysis position.
Included DC binding failures and ready/pending FFT warnings retain physical card origins. Deferred MC reporting spans retain checkpoint compatibility while source-law changes remain identity-bound.
Cancellation at the first completion poll publishes no queued effects and consumes no pending draws.
limits: Forward analysis operands inside subcircuit definitions remain unsupported; scoped/parent completion needs demand-driven binding that preserves unused per-instance body declarations.
AnalysisCardError carries a line without an include path. Ordinary DC value errors and staged warning origins are covered here; complete physical metadata for typed analysis failures remains open.
Enclosing-scope forward temperature cases and provisional ngspice temperature domain errors remain open.
Pending cards snapshot available scope bindings and functions. General parser allocation budgets, peak-memory/throughput measurement, and cancellation inside compilation/classification remain open.
The public DC/AC/transient oracles and grammar-equivalence matrix do not numerically qualify every periodic/noise/mixed-signal solver.
All C00-C14 packages remain unfinished; control execution remains 5/29 and table control/document/adapter integration remains open.
Three existing unit tests remain ignored. These selected native/WASM/CLI configurations do not qualify every feature/provider/platform.
development_notes: The first native run exposed an incorrect new cancellation-test threshold: one successful poll was allowed before an assertion intended for first-poll cancellation. Corrected to threshold zero and reran the full native selection. Two public-test fixture assumptions (node spelling and parser random-position observation after invoking a solver) were corrected before final qualification. Final review identified that deferred FFT warnings bypassed ordinary line-end source attribution; the follow-up code commit fixes it and expands the included-card regression. The native, CLI, Clippy and optimized WASM checks recorded here were rerun after that fix.
